changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. On the COMPRESSOR page THR reads in dBFS where the compressor starts, following RAT (8, 15 and 18 dB later at 1:8, 1:4 and 1:2 than at MAX), and MUP reads the makeup gain in dB.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
